highlights.title: Design across the fold
highlights.description: Try continuous mosaics, across-fold hero photos and restrained layered layouts. Automatic design compares them with separate-page choices; you can disable cross-fold layouts or overlap.

highlights.title: Find replacement photos more easily
highlights.description: Search by filename, section or folder, filter to unused photos, and browse smaller batches of replacement and layout previews.

highlights.title: Correct photo suggestions in one place
highlights.description: Change story sections directly in AI results. Unknown categories stay flagged for review, even before face analysis runs.

highlights.title: Catch export problems before saving
highlights.description: Jump from the export checklist to affected spreads or missing originals. Resolution warnings now account for crop and zoom.

highlights.title: Add optional edge bleed
highlights.description: Repeat outer-edge pixels into PNG/JPEG or PDF bleed without stretching the trimmed design. Review a proof and your printer’s requirements.

highlights.title: Send feedback from Stillbounds
highlights.description: Report a bug or suggest an improvement from Home, Help or the activation screen. Reply email and system versions are optional; no photos, projects or logs are attached.
